Their sound is a blend of rock, folk, and pop elements. From songs like “Lost Your Home” to “Athleisure Fashionista” you can hear the band’s unique ability to blend inspiration from different genres within their music. Their debut album “Quarterlife”, recorded with Wolfgang Zimmerman (Susto, Brave Baby, Band of Horses) was released in September of 2024 and can be found on all streaming platforms. The group is currently recording an album with their producer Corey Campbell (Susto, Babe Club), continuing to build their presence in the Charleston music scene and beyond. The Simplicity The Simplicity may just be the best-kept secret in rock ‘n’ roll, but not for long. The Charleston, SC quartet—John Bias(guitar, vocals), Tommy Merritt (bass guitar), Drew Lewis (drums), and Connor Hollifield (guitar, vocals)—is ready to make their mark with a sound that fuses the rootsy grit of Americana, the attitude of punk, and the swagger of classic rock. If you haven’t heard of them yet, that’s about to change. With their debut album MONEY set for release on November 15th, 2024, The Simplicity is primed to explode onto the scene. The band’s influences read like a playlist of rock’s most iconic acts—Dylan, The Beatles, The Rolling Stones, Wilco, The White Stripes—but don’t mistake them for just another throwback. The Simplicity channels their heroes while creating something distinctly their own: a blend of tight riffs, infectious melodies, and a raw, unpolished energy that’s been missing in rock’s mainstream. Their 2022 EP DAHLIN’ was a statement of intent, a rough-and-tumble collection that introduced a band who refuses to be boxed in by genre lines. With MONEY, The Simplicity is ready to take their place among rock’s elite, capturing the defiance of punk and the soul of country, wrapped up in a blistering rock ‘n’ roll package. This is a band that doesn’t just play music—they embody it, living on the edge of chaos in the best possible way. If you’re looking for the next great rock act to lead the charge, The Simplicity is ready to take up the mantle. *By purchasing a ticket, you agree to receive emails from ARTIST and PROMOTER. *Show is 21+. Notes: Tounds w/ MIDS Saturday, August 29th, 2026 Charleston Pour House | Deck Stage 5:00PM Doors / 6:00PM Show $17 Advance / $22 Day of Show Tounds TOUNDS is a new band with a familiar soul. Hailing from Charleston, South Carolina, the group brings together members of some of the city’s most esteemed acts—Brave Baby, The Simplicity, Human Resources, and Ryan Bonner & The Dearly Beloved—forming a group of seasoned players with a fresh perspective. Blending the lush atmospheres of indie rock and pop, and the storytelling roots of the South, TOUNDS crafts music that feels cinematic and alive. Born out of late-night sessions, shared history, and a mutual love for chasing the perfect vibe, TOUNDS isn’t just a band—it’s a creative revival. With deep musical chemistry and a sharp vision for the future, they’re building something that feels both instantly familiar and completely their own. This is TOUNDS. Turn it up and tune in. MIDS The members of MIDS describe the project as an opportunity to hang out with one another as much as it is a band. The Columbia, S.C., group has lived out that ethos since fall 2018, when singer Dylan Dickerson, guitarist Jon Warf, bassist Cam Powell, and drummer Michael Crawford took their first gig despite having zero songs written – riding purely on the belief that jamming with a deadline would produce the material they needed. MIDS has proven that concept in the following six years, releasing two EPs and three full-length albums that blend equal parts composition and improvisation. While the arc of the band’s sound bends over each catalogue entry – from the lobotomized punk of “MISSION ACCOMPLISHED,” the grunge-fueled yawp of “PRESCRIPTION MIDS,” and the polyrhythmic meditation of their self-titled LP – the ensemble’s throughline remains their sense of experimental collaboration, which never fails to result in a strain of high-octane rock and roll that sounds unmistakably MIDS. *By purchasing a ticket, you agree to receive emails from ARTIST and PROMOTER. * Show is 18+.
